name: Level Lock+ Matter (US)

radios.note: Runs Bluetooth and Matter over Thread at the same time.

matter.note: CSA lists 'Level Lock+ (Matter)' with Thread and Bluetooth transports. Several listings exist for different firmware versions; the newest seen is firmware 3.6.2, certified 2026-02-04.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread, with Apple Home Key. Needs a HomePod mini, HomePod (2nd gen) or Apple TV 4K (3rd gen, Wi-Fi + Ethernet) as hub; other models need a separate Thread border router.

google_home.note: Matter over Thread; needs a Thread border router such as a Nest Hub (2nd gen).

alexa.note: Matter over Thread; needs an Echo or other Alexa device that is a Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Matter over Thread through a SmartThings hub that is a Thread border router.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Level page says Level Matter devices work locally through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router. Forum users report commissioning problems with the Level Bolt.

hubRequired.note: The Level app controls the lock directly over Bluetooth. Matter platforms and away-from-home control need a Thread border router.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread stays on the local network.

lockFit.note: Replaces your deadbolt (fit guide covers 1 3/4 in door thickness, 2 1/8 in bore). Do not confuse it with the Level Bolt, the retrofit model that keeps your keys.

keypad.note: Keypad is a separate accessory sold on its own.

power.note: Battery sits inside the bolt; Level gives about 6 to 12 months. Found in search results only, not opened.

summary: The Level Lock+ (Matter) is a compact deadbolt that talks Bluetooth and Matter over Thread at once, so one lock can join Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings. Apple Home owners can also open it with Home Key. Home Assistant works with it through its Matter integration. Every Matter platform needs a Thread border router, but the Level app works over Bluetooth without one.
caveats: Matter control needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini, Nest Hub (2nd gen) or Thread-capable Echo.
Existing Level Lock+ owners get Matter through a firmware update that Level says cannot be undone.
The keypad is a separate purchase.
Home Assistant forum users report pairing failures with Level locks on some Thread setups.
